metadata.dcterms:title: A Fourier-Free Density-Increment Proof of Roth's Theorem
metadata.dcterms:creator: THEOREM, ROTH’S
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We give an elementary, Fourier-free proof of Roth’s theorem. The proof follows Roth’s original density-increment strategy, but replaces the usual Fourier-analytic step with a direct combinatorial argument involving averages over sub-progressions.
